before: Candidate implementation, candidate compiler build and candidate performance measurements. Baseline profiles, layout models, upstream survey and previously measured comparison gaps were observed.
change: Replace the existing per-implementing-crate directory proof with one eval-always proof per foreign trait-defining crate. Traverse the frozen loaded-crate roster and existing directories; preserve the existing positive payload query and supplier order. Keep the same query slot and existing rmeta, and reserve a new incremental-version namespace.
cheap_pilot: Where available, two independent paired warm Cargo histories, counterbalanced P/C/C/P. Report all eight guest counts. Retain or stop on new cache, cold (>2% repeated instruction growth), or ordinary build regression. A fall in a proxy on its own cannot qualify a PR.
deliberate_scope: The first experiment changes dependency tracking only. It adds no persistent lookup table, second memoized query, or new metadata payload.
draft: Publish a new private draft only for a repeatable marginal, native correctness and build guards, with either the prospectively confirmed cumulative 2× instruction result plus a repeatable ordinary wall improvement, or a repeatable 20% reduction in the named rustc. A full 2× ordinary wall claim requires its own eight paired wall observations and independent repeat. All arm/source differences and failures stay visible.
independent_cumulative: If the marginal qualifies and native/build guards pass, compare the same candidate directly to corrected −22 on another fresh machine. Predeclare all eight ratios for the sum of eight rustcs strictly above 2 plus both half medians, and report bare Cargo wall independently. The prior median/worst instruction gaps were 34.053M/34.384M. The prior median wall gap was 247.50 ms.
latest: Ohm −22 is the signed release. Ohm #253 is a −23 qualification draft at enrollment, and Ohm Rust #337 changes LLVM debug-info only. Recheck release and implementation overlap before promotion.
native_requirements: First matching translated crate number; ordered supplier stable identities and keys; unchanged private-hash obligation for every legacy DefIndex supplier.

A new supplier, same supplier adding a second trait, last removal, moved supplier, reordered/aliased crate numbers, stable membership plus a changed positive payload, local trait, dense and empty directories.

A fresh incremental namespace refuses pre-change sessions in either direction. The rmeta wire remains unchanged. Check native input compatibility with stable configuration as well as same-role warm/cold/repeated sessions.

Use the existing real-edit eight-rustc / 37-product ordinary, no-edit, independently cold and linked native controls. Bind regular/compiler-private outputs by source identity, using within-SDK native receipts fixed before treatment scoring.
production_primary: Exactly eight preregistered, counterbalanced marginal parent/candidate pairs on independently seeded first edits. Sum retired userspace hardware instructions for precisely the eight actual Cargo-dispatched rustcs. Both four-pair medians and every pair must improve by more than 0.40% (1000*C < 996*P); report the raw pair values even on failure.
production_secondary: Ordinary blocking wall on separate visits restoring the same seed, whole Cargo-tree and individual rustc counters; primary wall status is reported separately from hardware counts. Named small compiler endpoint uv_metadata has a prespecified 20% threshold, with all pairs and both halves reported. Reuse the true ordinary cargo build guard on uv #20992, including both half medians and all paired ratios.
